NewsArticle.Title: Marriage
NewsArticle.Content:
Naomhan, priest of the Church of Our Lady of Light offers a priest of 21 levels or more to join a man and wife in holy matrimony.
Jilt, higgler of Piet now sells a Tuxedo, White Satin Gown, and a Wedding Veil at astronomical prices.
